questions.q: How do you open lineage view for a Power BI workspace?
options: From the workspace list view, open the View dropdown and select Lineage
It must be requested from Microsoft support
By exporting the workspace as a PDF
There is no way to view lineage inside Power BI itself
questions.explain: Lineage view is built into every workspace — accessed via the View dropdown's Lineage option, no setup required.

questions.q: What minimum role is required to view a workspace's lineage view?
options: Contributor
Viewer
No role is required — it's public to anyone
Only the original workspace creator can ever see it
questions.explain: Users need an Admin, Member, or Contributor role, plus a Power BI Pro license. Viewers cannot switch to lineage view.

questions.q: What happens when you select an artifact's double-arrow icon in lineage view?
options: Power BI highlights everything connected to that artifact, upstream and downstream, and dims everything else
The artifact is permanently deleted
It exports the entire workspace to Excel
It refreshes every semantic model in the workspace
questions.explain: This isolates one artifact's chain — the lesson calls it a one-click preview of the impact-analysis technique covered in depth in Chapter 3.

questions.q: What does selecting an artifact's card itself (not the double-arrow icon) do?
options: Opens a side panel with that artifact's metadata — sensitivity, endorsement, refresh time, and table list
Deletes the artifact from the workspace
Immediately opens Power BI Desktop
Converts the artifact from DirectQuery to Import mode
questions.explain: Selecting the card opens a metadata side panel, distinct from selecting the double-arrow icon, which highlights the artifact's connections in the diagram instead.

questions.q: In lineage view's canvas layout, in which direction does data generally flow?
options: Left to right — data sources and semantic models/dataflows, then reports, then dashboards
Right to left, from dashboards back to data sources
Top to bottom only, with no left-right structure
Lineage view does not have any consistent layout direction
questions.explain: The canvas lays out artifacts left to right in the direction data actually flows: sources and semantic models/dataflows, then reports, then dashboards.
